## Required execution

1. Use explicit --workspace-id 0b02adb6-a395-46bd-bd92-6fec14dee20e on every provider command. Freshly resolve and verify workspace, this Mission's exact project_id, and WorkspaceKnowledge project.
2. Re-page the scoped WorkspaceKnowledge project and resolve the exact record key. Exclude if missing, duplicate, or any scope/authority/freshness check fails. Do not infer approval from issue status.
3. Read the full record body and indexes afresh. Independently verify workspace/project, body scope, explicit consumer project applicability, WORKSPACE_AUTHORIZED visibility, APPROVED decision and actor/policy/evidence binding, CURRENT lifecycle, exact record key/version, recomputed proposal digest, unexpired validity and matching repository revision. Resolve the cited source/evidence/closure references needed for use. Body and scalar indexes must agree. The exact string a3f129fa-4028-4341-98dc-c8ec20c468ae must match this issue's provider project_id and the record's applicableProjectRefs exactly; any mismatch excludes the record.
4. Prepare a new Authorized Visible Context receipt for revision 2 or later of this Mission containing Mission/workspace/consumer project, fetchedAt, candidate/addendum identity, selected provider record ID/revision/content version, exact decision/proposal/source/evidence references, selected statement and limitations, plus any excluded records and reasons. Retain the invalid first receipt only as historical evidence.
5. Pass only the new, validated Authorized Visible Context, with provenance and limitations intact, into the new worker input and use it to classify candidate-bound S01 evidence. Current Mission evidence remains authoritative. Specifically preserve the two candidate identities when the producer envelope and current candidate differ; keep validator and fixture-test outcomes separate; keep per-run instruction consumption UNVERIFIED absent run-bound evidence; and leave RC10VAL-8/RC10VAL-9 product context unadjudicated. These are checks against evidence, not permission to repair, relabel or promote it.
6. Have an independent Reviewer and independent Verifier assess the same corrected Mission revision and exact superseding context receipt/result sequentially. Bind each verdict to its target revision and relevant digests. Preserve any failed or partial result; do not restart automatically.
7. Return one fan-in report with the original failure, correction evidence, command/run hashes, record revision/version, corrected context receipt and worker-input reference, selected/excluded outcome, independent review/verification, and limitations. Leave this Mission in_review for Human acceptance; do not mark Human DONE and do not launch S02.

## Boundaries

Read-only against WorkspaceKnowledge, ProductKB, Core, source repositories, runtime configuration and prior Missions. No knowledge record creation/update/versioning, no ProductKB or fixture/code changes, no production deployment/promotion, and no Claude CLI in this local workspace. Keep concurrent Swarm runs within the existing profile limit and below 8 GB memory. An empty Authorized Visible Context is a valid safe outcome if eligibility cannot be established; never silently use an excluded record.
